operator_corrections: You missed, you clicked the street, and then you clicked buy mode.
Buy mode after intended Live object click = assume clicked off; run arm process — that is the task when this flag fires, not explore Buy.
STOP world hard-coded XY. Do not click again until PrintWindow shows workstation (not street/Buy).
ARM: Shift+Enter (lot center) to return to active lot after miss/off-lot.
